description: This file defines a custom authentication success handler for Spring Security, extending the default handler to manage redirect logic after user authentication.

classes.name: ServicesAuthenticationSuccessHandler
classes.description: A custom Spring Security success handler that manages redirect behavior after user login, utilizing request cache to determine target URL.

methods.name: onAuthenticationSuccess
methods.description: Handles successful authentication events, deciding whether to redirect to a saved request URL or proceed with the default behavior.

methods.name: setRequestCache
methods.description: Setter for the requestCache, allowing injection or modification of the caching strategy.
